notes: Level one is «أبي» (bare relation) and «جماعة مشايخي» (unnamed) together; «الحسن بن علي الزيتوني وغيره» is named plus an unnamed «غيره»; the blessings «(رحمه الله)» and «ره» are left out
«والحسن بن محبوب عن أبي حمزة عن علي بن الحسين» is a second isnad for the same saying («قالا»), so it is a second group; its head is not written in the text, so it starts at Hasan b. Mahbub
Reading note: the «و» after «أبي عبد الله» could also join two co-transmitters at one level; I read it as a second isnad because Hasan b. Mahbub narrates from Abu Hamza, not from Abu Basir
